headline: New Atmos Rewards Credit Card Offers: Up to 80,000 Points and Companion Fares
reasoning: This topic is highly relevant to TERRYTORY Travel readers as it directly impacts points and miles strategy, offering actionable opportunities for earning significant travel rewards. The information is timely, detailing current credit card offers that readers can apply for to save money on future travel, and comes from a credible source in the travel rewards space.
summary: Atmos Rewards, the loyalty program for Alaska and Hawaiian Airlines, has released new welcome bonuses on its co-branded credit cards, offering up to 80,000 points and companion fares with lower spending requirements.

source_articles.title: New bonuses on Atmos Rewards credit cards: Up to 80,000 points, companion fares and more
